'''Wijunkee''' was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]].

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]'' shows a picture of [[Debbie Dixon]] in the Wijunkee costume.
[[File:Debbie_Dixon.jpg|thumb|right|Debbie Dixon.]]
